CAMB.description: FCM Camber Control (CAMB). A single-instance bridge specialization record identifying the three model groups by name that drive free-cantilever-method camber calculation: the body (girder) element group, the support node group, and the key-segment group.

BODY_GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the structure/element group containing the bridge girder (body) elements used for camber control. Resolved to an internal group key at write time.

SUPP_GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the node group holding the support (pier-table) nodes. Resolved to an internal group key at write time.

KEYSEG_GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the group containing the key-segment (closure) elements. Resolved to an internal group key at write time.
